text:
I can't say whether this asset has lost tree cover since 2020, because the analysis never ran. The land-change tool returned an error: the source coverage the asset needs hasn't been prepared, so no observation was made. The run metadata only shows the intended setup, which was a 31 Dec 2020 baseline, a 30% tree-cover threshold, a 0.5 ha minimum event size, and Hansen/UMD and JRC GFC2020 data. It contains no results.

The asset's area is also missing from the metadata (null), so there's no figure to anchor any estimate.

This is not evidence of "no loss". It means there is no information either way.

To get an answer, the coverage preparation needs to be completed for ASSET-J and the analysis rerun. I can then interpret the results, including whether any detected loss meets the corroboration rule.
